record_title: The AR(1) KLT-to-DCT endpoint is nonuniform in block length
provenance: Asymptotic analysis of the exact AR(1) KLT phase equation and DCT-core factorization in arXiv:2609.20221, with comparison to classical AR(1) KLT formulas.
limitations: The theorem is for fixed low mode indices as block length grows; it gives a first-row operator-norm obstruction rather than a uniform all-mode transform error or coding-gain theorem.
